title: Bontrager Aeolus Pro TLR Road Tire
notes: Official Trek US page read 2026-11-01: US$64.99. Pro TLR construction, 120 TPI with bead-to-bead puncture protection; Road Dual-Compound (65a/57a); semi-slick; tubeless ready/clincher; 'fast-rolling efficiency with everyday durability'. 700C x 28 mm 335 g, max 90 psi; 30 mm 353 g, 80 psi; 32 mm 385 g, 75 psi. No hookless statement.
